Summary: On October 16, 2026, the FRED calendar lists several economic data releases, including the Euro Short Term Rate at 1:00 am, Harmonized Indices of Consumer Prices (HICP) at 5:00 am, SOFR Averages and Index Data at 7:00 am, and the St. Louis Fed Economic News Index at 10:00 am, among others. FRED, maintained by the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis, offers over 300 macroeconomic-related data releases from various sources, including Board data. The FRED® API Version 1 allows users to retrieve economic data customized by source, release, category, series, and other preferences.
